name: cdp-ttl-completion
title: fix(publisher): CDP 探测 TTL 从探测完成时刻计时（票 5cx）
description: 自审 5cw 发现：缓存时间戳在 _probe_container_cdp_endpoint_uncached() 之前采样，Windows DNS 慢探测（最长约 12s）会让实际 TTL 缩短 12s（60s 窗口只剩 48s）。改为探测完成后取 _cdp_probe_cache 时间戳，TTL 语义准确。属 2 行修正，聚焦测试 3 例仍通过，全量回归后提交。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-04. Follow-up to 5cw found while self-reviewing the TTL cache: the cached timestamp was sampled before the blocking probe ran, so a slow probe (Windows DNS can take the full ~12s timeout) shortened the effective trust window from 60s to ~48s. The cache now stores time.monotonic() taken after the probe completes; the TTL now measures from when the answer became known. Two-line change, no behavior change in the happy path; the three TTL tests still pass and the full suite was re-run.
